This is an application seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR 453/2023, dated 20.07.2023, under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, lodged at Police Station Lajpat Nagar.

2. The applicant was granted interim protection by order dated 26.07.2024, subject to joining the investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer ["IO"].

Subsequent orders reveal that the applicant has not been adhering scrupulously to the above conditions.
The applicant however has placed on record medical documents to show that he is suffering from a serious illness, namely "Myasthenia Gravis", which is an auto-immune condition.
